nodes.label: Light logo mark: off-white bee-planet icon, no wordmark
nodes.rationale: 500×500 RGBA PNG. Corners and the center are alpha 0, so the ground is transparent; a black preview is the viewer, not painted pixels. One centered off-white mark and no lettering. The opaque fill is mostly RGB(247, 247, 251), with antialiased edges. Painted pixels sit about x 51–448 and y 116–382. Two detached curved strokes sit above a solid rounded head, like antennae. Under the head the body splits into left and right lobes around a narrow vertical gap. A thick horizontal elliptical ring crosses the middle; its rounded caps sit outside the body and the ring's inner hole shows on both sides. At the waist the gap opens into a four-pointed transparent cutout, so the sparkle is negative space rather than a white star. The lower body is two rounded lobes with the same central slit, joined by a short bridge at the bottom tip. No brand name, tagline, or other readable wordmark.
